exposure: Bakri balloon tamponade combined with B-lynch uterine compression sutures
Bakri balloon tamponade combined with modified Hayman suture
outcome: decrease in red blood cell and hemoglobin
cohort: 100 patients with pregnancy-induced hypertension (PIH) who had persistent bleeding after cesarean delivery (CD) and were unresponsive to uterine contractions, sutures, or uterine disconnection procedures
finding: While both Bakri balloon tamponade (BBT) combined with B-lynch uterine compression sutures and BBT combined with modified Hayman suture are comparable in managing postpartum hemorrhage in pregnant women with PIH undergoing CD, the latter resulted in less blood loss, attenuated inflammatory response, reduced impact on coagulation function and ovarian function, and a lower incidence of adverse events.
